title: Definition And Impact Of ICT On Society
definition: Information and Communication Technology (ICT) encompasses all digital technologies that facilitate the capture, transmission, processing, and display of information electronically, profoundly reshaping socio-economic, political, and cultural structures.
importanceInUpsc: Directly tested in GS Paper III (Science & Technology - IT, Applications, Social Impact) and GS Paper I/II (Social Empowerment, Governance, Inclusive Growth). Essential for writing multi-dimensional analytical answers in Mains and tackling policy-based MCQs in Prelims.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Definition And Impact Of ICT On Society.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Fundamental knowledge of e-governance and digital divide
